local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local ok,err=pcall(function() local PS=require(RS.Shared.PortScene) PS.build({portId='london',portName='london',level=3,shipId='galleon',hasShipyard=true,facilities={'bank','guild','harbormaster'},storyCount=0,companions={}},function() end) end) local c=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character if c and c:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') then c.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored=true c:PivotTo(CFrame.new(-6,6,10)) end workspace:SetAttribute('ShotFov',60) workspace:SetAttribute('ShotCF',CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-100,330,1),Vector3.new(-100,0,0),Vector3.new(0,1,0))) return tostring(ok)..tostring(err)

local f=workspace:FindFirstChild('PortScene') if not f then return 'NOSCENE' end local h={} for _,d in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('Humanoid') and d.Parent:IsA('Model') then local p=d.Parent:GetPivot().Position table.insert(h,p) end end local pairs2=0 for i=1,#h do for j=i+1,#h do local v=h[i]-h[j] if v.X*v.X+v.Z*v.Z<1.5*1.5 then pairs2+=1 end end end local a=function(k) return tostring(f:GetAttribute(k)) end return 'PORTQA london_L3 npc='..#h..' npcOverlapPairs='..pairs2..' route='..a('NpcRouteAudit')..' checked='..a('NpcRouteChecked')..' relocated='..a('NpcRouteRelocated')..' blocked='..a('NpcRouteBlocked')..' prop='..a('PropOverlapAudit')..' propChecked='..a('PropOverlapChecked')..' moved='..a('PropOverlapMoved')..' hidden='..a('PropOverlapHidden')
